def VTask.prev {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  let (as, _) := find_before_first l x h
  if h_as_empty : as.isEmpty then
    l.getLast (List.ne_nil_of_mem h)
  else
    as.getLast as.notisEmpty
